title: Database Cleanup "corrupts" database, showing "red line in" overview.
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.4.1.0-dev**
**Build**: 23f797e5
**Flavor**: Fullrelease

**Problem description:**
Database problem after Maintenance->Database Cleanup

After database cleanup AAPS shows "red line" in overview and in the "History browser" (including in the past).
As if loop was disabled (afaikt is was not)

**Additional information:**

Problem can be fixed through database reset + full NS sync

**Repro:**
Easy to repro at will by running "Database Cleanup" from maintenance.
Fix: database reset + full NS sync

**logs:**

**Screenshots:**

comments.body: red line only means there is no running mode data (not important anyway). what is corrupted?

> red line only means there is no running mode data (not important anyway).
Yes, but I think it should not get in this state after database cleanup (_not database reset_!)

> ... what is corrupted?
Hmmm... Maybe this is not the correct wording. However, loop is closed (and running afaik), red line is in overview as well as in AAPS full history view. This does not restore to "normal" after some time...

Cleaning the database used to simply clean, without interfering with normal AAPS operations.

Never mind for now....

Somehow the "problem" I encountered this morning solved itself? 🤨
Cant repro this anymore....

Will monitor/test this more.
